categories.description: Product discovery: problem framing, user research and interviews, jobs-to-be-done, personas, journey maps, market sizing, competitor research, opportunity trees and validation experiments
Product definition: PRDs, specs, user stories, acceptance criteria, tickets, prioritization, pre-mortems and grilling a plan before building
Frontend visual and interaction design: art direction, taste, anti-generic UI, landing pages, design systems and tokens, typography, color, motion, accessibility and UI polish
System architecture: domain modeling, deep modules, module boundaries, ADRs, API and contract design, hexagonal and clean architecture, backend patterns
Technology selection and tooling: research before choosing libraries, prototypes, TypeScript, Bun, Postgres, migrations, Docker, deployment, MCP servers and OpenRouter
Rust: idioms, error handling, concurrency, tokio, axum web services, clap CLIs and rusqlite/SQLite
Web app engineering: React, Next.js, Vite, component composition, performance, SEO, browser and E2E testing, Vercel deployment
Mobile apps: Expo, React Native, Expo Router and React Navigation, native UI, animations, data fetching, EAS builds and app store submission, SwiftUI, Android and Flutter
Testing and verification: test-driven development, debugging, code review and proving work is done
Agent skills: finding, installing, writing, evaluating and A/B testing skills and skill sets
Agent workflow: implementation plans, subagent orchestration, superorchestrator, git worktrees, parallel agents and handoffs
